analysis.summary: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited reported consolidated revenues from operations of INR56.9 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 22% year-on-year growth. EBITDA increased 27% year-on-year to INR8.3 crores with margins improving to 14.6%, while PAT stood at INR4 crores, growing 25% year-on-year. Management highlighted growth across its product and services segments, including Patient Support Programs (PSP) and B2B health camps, and noted ongoing progress in acquiring the remaining stake in Saarathi Healthcare by the end of Q2 FY27. QMS Medical Allied Services reported a strong start to Q1 FY27 with revenue reaching Rs. 56.9 crore and a PAT of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management guided for approximately INR90 crores to INR100 crores of service revenue visibility for the year.
guidance.quote: However, for now, you can consider that. And we've guided approximately INR90 crores to INR100 crores of service revenue visibility for this year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the net overall contribution to PSP with operations revenue will be around INR100 crores to INR105 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, our net overall contribution to the PSP with operations revenue, it will be around INR100 crores to INR105 crores in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management maintained the top-line guidance for the total top line of around INR220 crores.
guidance.quote: We would want to maintain that guidance because we just finished quarter 1, we are in mid of quarter 2.

guidance.claim: Management maintained the EBITDA margin guidance for FY27.
guidance.quote: So, if you look at the current numbers and we set a ramp-up, I would want to continue to maintain the guidance and not change anything at least in quarter three.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Indian healthcare industry offers strong long-term growth opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: India healthcare industry continues to offer a strong long-term growth opportunities supported by rising healthcare awareness, increase in healthcare spending, expanding access to health care and the rapid adoption of digital health solution.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that as pharmaceutical companies focus on patient access, adherence, and outcomes, demand for the integrated PSP platform is expected to grow.
demand_outlook.quote: As pharmaceutical companies increasingly focused on improving patient access, adherence and outcomes we expect demand for our integrated and technology-enabled PSP platform to continue growing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the products business demonstrated healthy traction supported by the expanding distribution network and Q-Devices portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Products business continued to demonstrate healthy traction, supported by our expanding distribution network, Q-Devices portfolio and presence across QMSMEDS, e-Grameen and other digital platforms.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that chronic disease burdens and rising health awareness are driving demand for tailored Patient Support Programs.
demand_outlook.quote: Chronic Disease Surge: Rising diabetes, cancer, and heart disease increase demand for tailored PSPs

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the Services business continued to emerge as a key growth engine.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, our Services business continued to emerge as a key growth engine, driven by deeper pharma partnerships, increasing adoption of Patient Support Programs and the scaling of our healthcare camp operations.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are progressing towards acquiring the remaining stake in Saarathi Healthcare, expected to be completed by the end of quarter 2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently hold a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and are progressing towards acquiring the remaining stake, which we expect to complete by the end of quarter 2 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA grew 27% year-on-year to INR8.3 crores with EBITDA margin improving to 14.6%.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, our EBITDA grew faster than revenue, increasing 27% year on to INR8.3 crores with the EBITDA margin improving 14.6% compared with 14.1% in Q1 FY '26 and 13.3% in the Q4 FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that gross margin expansion was driven by a higher revenue contribution coming from services.
margins_costs.quote: The margin increase is driven by the shift of our revenue from the revenue contribution; a higher contribution is coming from services. So that is a driver for the expansion of gross margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that PSPs are typically cost-plus contracts with an annual contract basis.
margins_costs.quote: So, our PSPs are typically cost-plus contracts. So, the employee cost plus the administration cost, plus cost of other allied services are charged to the client, and we have a markup. And PSPs typically work on an annual contract basis.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA margins improved to 14.6% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We delivered revenue of Rs. 56.9 crore, growing 22% YoY, while EBITDA increased 27% YoY to Rs. 8.3 crore, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.6%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated the proprietary technology platform supports 100-plus programs and more than 1 million patients.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, our proprietary technology platform supports 100-plus programs and more than 1 million patients providing real brand tracking, monitoring, analytics and patient engagement capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: Management announced conducting more than 11,497 B2B health camps in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We are very pleased to announce that we have conducted more than 11,497 B2B health camps in the Quarter 1 FY '27 demonstrating the depth of our field execution capabilities and the trust based on us by our profitable factors.

orders_capacity.claim: The company conducted 11,497 B2B health camps during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we also conducted 11,497 B2B health camps, demonstrating our growing execution capabilities and reach.

capital_allocation.claim: The company currently holds a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare.
capital_allocation.quote: We currently hold a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and expect to acquire the balance stake by the end of Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the acquisition of the remaining stake in Saarathi Healthcare is expected to be completed by the end of quarter 2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We currently hold a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and are progressing towards acquiring the remaining stake, which we expect to complete by the end of quarter 2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to acquire the balance stake in Saarathi Healthcare by the end of Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We currently hold a 76% stake in Saarathi Healthcare and expect to acquire the balance stake by the end of Q2FY27.
